name: Davis Road Data Centre (Project Blue Tongue, 3 Davis Road)

address.value: 3 Davis Road, Wetherill Park NSW 2164 (Lot 1 DP 864615)
address.note: SSD-59416728 EIS and assessment report: 3 Davis Road, Lot 1 DP 864615, 10.54 ha, existing 'Reservoir Distribution Centre'. The EIS says the neighbouring property to the east has tenancies of Freight Specialists and Stockland; Stockland's Wetherill Park Distribution Centre is 2 Davis Road, the site of a separate Stockland/EdgeConneX data centre proposal (IDA list Mar 2026, source 4). Previous value '2 Davis Road' conflated the two.

lat.note: geocoded: NSW address point for 3 Davis Road Wetherill Park (previous value -33.83821,150.91044 was the 2 Davis Road point)

builder.note: Lendlease 'Project Blue Tongue' page: works commenced Apr 2025 after SSDA and CC; hosts the SSD-59416728 development consent. Post-approval plans use Lendlease document codes (SYD067-LLC-...).

developer.value: Amazon Web Services (via applicant Cundall Johnston and Partners Pty Ltd)
developer.note: SSD applicant Cundall acting for an unnamed data centre operator; Cundall's Jan 2025 notice of commencement says 'AWS would like to notify ... our intention to commence construction' (source 9); post-approval EMP titled 'Amazon Web Services Data Centre DC01 SYD067' (source 6). Stockland/EdgeConneX JV relates to 2 Davis Road, not this consent.

mw_it.note: EIS: two buildings each 'power consumption of 80 megawatts (MW) (each with approximately 66MW IT load)' plus tape storage building 0.85 MW (~430 kW IT). Lendlease describes a 60 MW first building with provision for a second.

mw_grid.note: Assessment report: 'Maximum power capacity 160.85 megawatts (MW)' (2 x 80 MW + 0.85 MW). The portal project description says 'overall power consumption of 180 megawatts'; HV substation 3 x 90 MVA.

cost_aud_m.note: Capital investment value $1,597,338,256 (assessment report; EIS s1.5; Turner & Townsend CIV report, source 11). Previous value A$1.2bn (Willowtree summary, source 5) superseded.

lodged.note: lodgement date not stated; SEARs issued 28 Jun 2023; EIS exhibited 19 Mar - 15 Apr 2024 (source 1)

jobs_construction.note: EIS s1.6.1: '556 full-time equivalent (FTE) jobs', derived as average daily work hours / 8 'including onsite and offsite labour' (218 FTE per data centre building x2, 60 substation, 60 tape storage) 'consistently throughout the lifetime of development build'; EIS elsewhere 'approximately 556 direct construction jobs'. Assessment report: 'up to 556 construction jobs' / '556 full-time equivalent construction jobs'.

jobs_operational.note: EIS s1.6.2: engineering operations 17 staff/shift x 2 shifts + 4 managers = 38, plus data centre operations 34 staff = '72 jobs'. Assessment report Table 2 says '73 operational jobs' but its summary says 72.

construction_start.note: Lendlease: works commenced Apr 2025. Cundall notice (14 Jan 2025) gave intended commencement of site civil and DC01 stage on 13 Feb 2025 (source 9). The Stockland 'FY27' construction statement relates to the separate 2 Davis Road JV site.

construction_end.note: not found; assessment report: construction over about two years in 4 stages (DC01, fit-out, DC02, fit-out); master.csv year 2027 unverified
